# Hindustan Times

> India's leading digital news portal delivering breaking news, live updates, and comprehensive coverage across politics, entertainment, sports, technology, and lifestyle.

Hindustan Times is a major Indian news organization offering real-time coverage of domestic and international events, with specialized sections for cricket, entertainment, technology, and regional content in multiple languages including Bengali. The platform combines breaking news reporting with premium analysis, lifestyle content, and interactive features.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- India News
- World News
- Live Updates
- Cricket
- Entertainment
- Technology
- Politics
- US News
- Middle East Conflict
- Lifestyle
- Trending
- HT Premium
- Regional News
- Business News

## Core News Hubs

- [Homepage](https://www.hindustantimes.com): Homepage offering breaking news, India/world coverage, cricket, entertainment & lifestyle
- [India News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news): India news section with breaking headlines, real-time coverage & current events
- [World News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news): Global news hub covering international developments, conflicts & world events
- [US News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news): US news hub covering politics, crime, defense, technology & entertainment updates
- [City News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities): Local news from Indian metro cities including Delhi, Noida, Kolkata & Lucknow

## Live Coverage & Breaking Events

- [US-Iran War Live Updates](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-iran-war-live-updates-israel-strait-of-hormuz-tehran-trump-netanyahu-tel-aviv-jerusalem-eid-oil-prices-dubai-uae-101773967484013.html): Live war coverage of Iran-Israel conflict with missile strikes & military operations
- [Dubai & Abu Dhabi News Live Updates](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/abu-dhabi-dubai-news-live-updates-uae-war-news-march-20-drone-missile-attack-qatar-strait-of-hormuz-iran-israel-us-101773969074036.html): Live coverage of Middle East conflict with drone attacks, UAE defense operations

## Sports & Entertainment

- [Cricket](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket): Cricket hub with live scores, match updates, IPL coverage & tournament analysis
- [Entertainment](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment): Entertainment section with Bollywood, Hollywood news, celebrity gossip & interviews
- [HTCity](https://www.hindustantimes.com/htcity): HTCity entertainment lifestyle hub with food, cinema, wellness & travel guides

## Lifestyle & Technology

- [Lifestyle](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle): Lifestyle hub with fashion, beauty, wellness, relationships & travel content
- [Technology](https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology): Technology section covering mobile, gadgets, laptops, gaming & internet trends
- [Cars & Bikes](https://www.hindustantimes.com/car-bike): Automobile news section with car/bike launches, reviews & industry updates
- [Astrology](https://www.hindustantimes.com/astrology): Astrology section with daily horoscopes, tarot, numerology & zodiac insights

## Trending & Viral Content

- [Trending](https://www.hindustantimes.com/trending): Trending content hub with viral videos, memes, puzzles & feel-good stories

## Premium & Regional

- [HT Premium](https://www.hindustantimes.com/ht-exclusive): Premium subscription service with exclusive news analysis & premium content
- [HT Bangla](https://www.hindustantimes.com/bangla): Bengali language news portal with entertainment, sports & regional coverage

## Optional

- [Games](https://www.hindustantimes.com/games): Free online games including crossword, sudoku, puzzles & brain teasers
- [HT The Next Voice](https://www.hindustantimes.com/ht-the-next-voice): National student video contest for storytelling, acting, singing & spoken word
